item.title: Does school food actually cause metabolic issues?
item.description: Clinical data on school meal fiber ratios is missing. item.title: Does predictive policing actually create racial bias?
item.description: Predictive policing does not show significant racial bias in arrests. A randomized trial found no significant differences in the proportion of arrests by racial-ethnic group during these deployments. The evidence is mixed, showing that while runaway feedback loops are a theoretical and modeled risk, empirical data from a randomized trial did not show significant racial bias in arrests.
